text: It uses a vapor-compression cycle. The compressor pressurizes refrigerant vapor. This high-pressure vapor enters the condenser coils, releasing heat and turning into a high-pressure liquid. The expansion valve controls the flow into the evaporator, causing a pressure drop and flash vaporization into a low-pressure liquid/vapor mixture. In the evaporator, absorbing heat from inside the fridge, the refrigerant turns completely into a low-pressure vapor, which returns to the compressor to repeat the cycle.
